facts.content: For acute upper respiratory tract infection or bronchitis, the plan is symptomatic care with expectation of viral self-resolution over one to two weeks.

facts.content: Patient is advised to seek urgent reevaluation if temperature is persistently at or above 37.5–38°C, cough is worsening, new purulent sputum develops, haemoptysis or epistaxis occurs, or if new or worsening shortness of breath or chest pain occurs.
